scope: Three ordinary post-entry repairs, before the completion experiment. Plans are unedited model outputs. No physical outcomes are implied.

plan.objective: Use the attack-trigger damage already available to finish the opponent this turn; do not develop or reserve mana when the winning attack resolves.
plan.guidance: Current facts: opponent is at 6. Kellan is a 3/2 double striker; Soulstone Sanctuary is an eligible 3/3 vigilant creature; Challenger can attack but is only 2 power, and its lizard ally Claw is summoning sick. Opponent’s 8/10 Explorer can block one attacker but has no trample and cannot prevent other attackers’ damage. Attack with Kellan and Sanctuary, then attack with Challenger: this also triggers Hired Claw for 1 damage. This is at least 10 combat damage even if Explorer blocks one attacker, plus Claw’s 1 damage, so lethal. Do not cast Smaug or upgrade Kellan; three available mana cannot cast Smaug, and no development is needed. No opponent-turn reserve is relevant once lethal resolves. If an unexpected blocker/protection or response changes the lethal calculation, reassess; do not assume Explorer blocks multiple attackers.

plan.guidance: No lethal now: unblocked Kellan would deal 6 but Explorer blocks and kills Kellan, while the only hand card Smaug cannot be cast with three mana. Attack with Challenger and Sanctuary; Claw is summoning sick. The Claw trigger deals 1 to opponent. Keep Kellan back. Preserve both Mountains and Sanctuary untapped; no instant is in hand, so there is no actual response spell. If Explorer attacks, block with Kellan; its lack of trample means no damage reaches you even though Kellan dies.

plan.objective: Take the immediate lethal attack opportunity, including triggering Hired Claw; develop Smaug only if a postcombat window and mana permit.
plan.guidance: Current roster is Challenger 2/2, Claw 1/2 (summoning sick), Kellan 3/2 double strike, and animated Sanctuary 3/3 vigilance. Opponent is at 6 with tapped-out, summoning-sick 8/10 Explorer; you have 18 life. Attacking with Kellan for six plus Claw's one damage trigger is lethal if Kellan is not blocked. Since Explorer can block and kill Kellan, attack with all currently eligible attackers: Challenger, Kellan, and Sanctuary; Kellan can be blocked, while Challenger and Sanctuary together contribute five and Claw trigger adds one, so that is lethal if both get through. Prefer attack all eligible for maximum pressure; Claw cannot attack. No burn in hand. Smaug costs 2RR, but only three mana are untapped and there is no land play; don't cast now. Preserve mana only as useful opportunity; no known instant is available. If Explorer attacks on opponent turn, any single blocker fully prevents its damage (no trample), though losing one is likely preferable to allowing 8 damage; choose a blocker that preserves the strongest pressure, and do not sacrifice Kellan unnecessarily if alternatives exist.
